svg.aria-label: Sine waveform, 1 cycle shown, oscillating symmetrically above and below a zero reference axis. A peak reference line marks the maximum height above the zero axis, and a peak-to-peak bracket spans from the peak line to the trough line. A separate RMS reference line sits between the zero axis and the peak line, at about 71 percent of the peak height. A period marker spans exactly one full cycle along the time axis.
